title: ACL Reconstruction — The First 12 Weeks Decide the Outcome

hook.en: Return to sport after an ACL reconstruction is months away, but the first weeks set everything up: a knee that does not fully straighten or a quadriceps that will not switch on causes problems for years. Learn the early goals, the exercises that reach them and the warning signs to act on.
hook.ur: ACL reconstruction ke baad khel mein wapsi mahinon door hai, magar pehle hafte sab kuch tay karte hain: jo ghutna poora seedha na ho ya jo quadriceps on na ho, woh saalon masla deta hai. Shuruati goals, un tak pohanchane wali exercises aur qadam uthane wali warning signs seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll set the four early goals (full extension, quadriceps control, swelling control, normal walking), choose exercises for each, progress from weeks 0 to 12 by criteria, and recognise complications such as loss of extension, infection and clots.
goal.ur: End tak aap chaar shuruati goals (poora extension, quadriceps control, sujan par qaboo, normal chalna) tay karenge, har ek ke liye exercises chunenge, criteria ke zariye hafta 0 se 12 tak barhayenge, aur extension khone, infection aur clot jaisi paicheedgiyan pehchanenge.

text.en: After **ACL reconstruction** (often with a hamstring or patellar tendon graft), the early goals are simple but essential: **full knee extension** (as straight as the other knee), **active quadriceps control** (a straight-leg raise without a lag), **minimal swelling** and **normal walking**. Losing extension early is one of the most common and troublesome problems, and quadriceps weakness can persist for years. Progress is based on **criteria, not dates**: a quiet knee (little swelling), full extension and good quadriceps control before running, which is usually around **3 months**. Return to sport is much later — usually **9 months or more**.
text.ur: **ACL reconstruction** ke baad (aksar hamstring ya patellar tendon graft ke saath) shuruati goals saade magar zaroori hain: **ghutne ka poora extension** (doosre ghutne jitna seedha), **active quadriceps control** (baghair lag ke straight-leg raise), **kam se kam sujan** aur **normal chalna**. Shuru mein extension khona sab se aam aur pareshan kun masail mein se hai, aur quadriceps ki kamzori saalon reh sakti hai. Behtari **criteria par, tareekhon par nahi**: daurne se pehle pursukoon ghutna (kam sujan), poora extension aur quadriceps ka achha control, jo aam taur par takreeban **3 mahine** par hota hai. Khel mein wapsi bohat baad — aam taur par **9 mahine ya zyada**.

text.en: Early ACL rehab is like **setting the foundation of a house**. Nobody admires a foundation, but if it is crooked (a bent knee) or weak (a sleepy quadriceps), every floor built on top later — running, jumping, cutting — is unstable.
text.ur: Shuruati ACL rehab **ghar ki buniyad rakhne** jaisa hai. Koi buniyad ki tareef nahi karta, magar agar woh terhi (mora ghutna) ya kamzor (soya hua quadriceps) ho, to baad mein ooper bani har manzil — daurna, koodna, murna — ghair mustahkam hoti hai.

steps.title: Weeks 0 to 2 — extension, quadriceps, swelling
steps.detail: Heel on a rolled towel with the knee unsupported (prone hang or supine heel prop) to gain extension; quad sets and straight-leg raises; ice, compression and elevation; walking with crutches, weight-bearing as allowed. || Hafta 0 se 2 — extension, quadriceps, sujan

steps.title: Weeks 2 to 6 — normal walking and early strength
steps.detail: Wean crutches once walking is normal without a limp; mini-squats, step-ups, bridges, calf raises, stationary cycling; bend towards about 120 degrees. Use NMES if the quadriceps lags. || Hafta 2 se 6 — normal chalna aur shuruati taqat

steps.title: Weeks 6 to 12 — strength and control
steps.detail: Progress squats, lunges, leg press and single-leg balance; build hamstring strength (with care for a hamstring graft, as the surgeon advises). || Hafta 6 se 12 — taqat aur control

steps.title: Around 12 weeks — the running gate
steps.detail: Start a running programme only when the knee is quiet (little swelling), extension is full, flexion is good, there is no pain on hopping-type tests at low level and quadriceps strength is adequate as your clinic measures it. || Takreeban 12 hafte — daurne ka darwaza

question.en: Which early goal is the most urgent in the first two weeks?
question.ur: Pehle do hafton mein sab se fori shuruati goal kaun sa hai?

text.en: Full knee extension, equal to the other side
text.ur: Ghutne ka poora extension, doosri taraf ke barabar

feedback.en: Yes — lost extension is hard to regain later and changes walking.
feedback.ur: Haan — khoya hua extension baad mein wapas lena mushkil hai aur chalna badal deta hai.

feedback.en: Not a goal for the first weeks.

title.en: Early problems and what to do

rows.en: The knee rests bent, walking with a bent knee
rows.ur: Ghutna mora hua rehta hai, mora ghutna le kar chalna

rows.en: Heel props, prone hangs; tell the surgeon if not improving by about 4 to 6 weeks
rows.ur: Heel props, prone hangs; takreeban 4 se 6 hafte tak behtar na ho to surgeon ko batayein

rows.en: The knee bends during a straight-leg raise
rows.ur: Straight-leg raise mein ghutna mur jata hai
Quad sets, NMES, sujan kam karein

rows.en: A puffy, warm knee after exercise
rows.ur: Exercise ke baad phula, garam ghutna

rows.en: Reduce the load, ice, compression; review the programme
rows.ur: Load kam karein, barf, compression; programme ka jaiza

rows.en: Increasing pain, redness, fever, wound discharge
rows.ur: Barhta dard, surkhi, bukhar, zakhm se pani

text.en: **Straight, strong, settled.** Get the knee straight, the quadriceps strong and the swelling settled before progressing.
text.ur: **Seedha, mazboot, pursukoon.** Aage barhne se pehle ghutna seedha, quadriceps mazboot aur sujan pursukoon karein.

text.en: **Putting a pillow under the knee for comfort.** It feels good but lets the knee stiffen in a bent position. Support the calf or heel so the knee can fall straight, and never sleep with a pillow under the knee.
text.ur: **Aaram ke liye ghutne ke neeche takiya rakhna.** Achha lagta hai magar ghutne ko mori position mein akarne deta hai. Pindli ya aedi ko sahara dein taake ghutna seedha ho sake, aur kabhi ghutne ke neeche takiya rakh kar na soyein.

question.en: At 3 weeks a patient walks with a limp and cannot do a straight-leg raise without the knee bending. What helps most?
question.ur: 3 hafte par mareez langra kar chalta hai aur ghutna more baghair straight-leg raise nahi kar sakta. Sab se zyada kya madad karega?

text.en: Stop all exercise until it settles
text.ur: Theek hone tak sab exercise band karein

feedback.ur: Aaram quadriceps ko aur kamzor karta hai.

text.en: Quadriceps activation work, NMES if needed, swelling control, and crutches until the gait is normal
text.ur: Quadriceps activation ka kaam, zaroorat ho to NMES, sujan par qaboo, aur chal normal hone tak baisakhiyan

feedback.en: Yes — restore quadriceps control before dropping crutches.
feedback.ur: Haan — baisakhiyan chhorne se pehle quadriceps control bahal karein.

text.ur: Taqat ke liye jogging shuru karein

feedback.en: Running needs a quiet knee and good strength first.
feedback.ur: Daurne ke liye pehle pursukoon ghutna aur achhi taqat chahiye.

question.ur: Daurna aam taur par kab shuru ho sakta hai?

text.en: Around 3 months, once the knee is quiet, extension is full and strength meets the clinic's criteria
text.ur: Takreeban 3 mahine, jab ghutna pursukoon ho, extension poora ho aur taqat clinic ke criteria poore kare

feedback.en: Yes — the criteria matter more than the date.
feedback.ur: Haan — criteria tareekh se zyada ahem hain.

feedback.en: Running usually starts much earlier; return to sport takes longer.
feedback.ur: Daurna aam taur par bohat pehle shuru hota hai; khel mein wapsi zyada waqt leti hai.

text.en: At 3 weeks if pain is low
text.ur: 3 hafte par agar dard kam ho

feedback.en: Too early for the graft and the knee.
feedback.ur: Graft aur ghutne ke liye bohat jaldi.

text.en: **Measure, do not guess.** Record extension (heel-height difference or goniometry), flexion, the straight-leg raise and swelling (a stroke test) every visit. Showing the patient their numbers keeps them motivated during the long middle months, when the knee feels fine but is not yet ready for sport.
text.ur: **Naapein, andaza na lagayein.** Har visit par extension (aedi ki oonchai ka farq ya goniometry), flexion, straight-leg raise aur sujan (stroke test) likhein. Mareez ko us ke numbers dikhana lambe darmiyani mahinon mein himmat banaye rakhta hai, jab ghutna theek lagta hai magar abhi khel ke liye tayyar nahi.

question.en: Why is return to sport usually not before 9 months?
question.ur: Khel mein wapsi aam taur par 9 mahine se pehle kyun nahi hoti?

answer.en: The graft continues to remodel for many months, and strength, hop symmetry and confidence take time to recover. Studies show the risk of a second ACL injury falls considerably for each month return is delayed up to about 9 months, and is lower when strength and hop tests meet the criteria.
answer.ur: Graft kai mahine tak remodel hota rehta hai, aur taqat, hop ki barabari aur aitmaad wapas aane mein waqt lagta hai. Studies dikhati hain ke tagriban 9 mahine tak wapsi mein har mahine ki takheer se doosri ACL chot ka khatra kaafi kam hota hai, aur jab taqat aur hop tests criteria poore karein to kam hota hai.

beats.patient: A 21-year-old footballer is 1 week after an ACL reconstruction with a hamstring graft. His knee rests at 8 degrees short of straight, he has a quadriceps lag on straight-leg raise and a moderately swollen knee.
beats.assessment: He has early extension loss and quadriceps inhibition, the two problems to fix first.
beats.treatment: Heel props and prone hangs several times a day, quad sets with NMES, ice, compression and elevation, crutches until he walks without a limp, and no pillow under the knee.
beats.reassess: By week 3 his knee is fully straight, he lifts his leg without a lag and walks normally without crutches; he starts running at 13 weeks once the criteria are met.

text.en: **Contact the surgical team urgently** for fever, wound redness or discharge, or a hot, very swollen, increasingly painful knee (possible infection), or a hot, swollen, painful calf or breathlessness (possible clot). **Tell the surgeon** if extension is not improving by about 4 to 6 weeks, or if the knee locks or gives way.
text.ur: **Surgical team se fori rabta karein** bukhar, zakhm mein surkhi ya pani, ya garam, bohat soojhe, barhte dard wale ghutne (mumkina infection), ya garam, soojhi, dardnak pindli ya saans phoolne (mumkina clot) par. **Surgeon ko batayein** agar takreeban 4 se 6 hafte tak extension behtar na ho, ya ghutna lock ho ya dagmagaye.

summary.en: The early goals after ACL reconstruction are full extension, quadriceps control, minimal swelling and normal walking.
summary.ur: ACL reconstruction ke baad shuruati goals poora extension, quadriceps control, kam se kam sujan aur normal chalna hain.

summary.en: Progress by criteria: heel props and quad work first, then strength and control, and running around 3 months once the knee is quiet and strong.
summary.ur: Criteria ke zariye barhein: pehle heel props aur quad ka kaam, phir taqat aur control, aur takreeban 3 mahine par daurna jab ghutna pursukoon aur mazboot ho.

summary.en: Never put a pillow under the knee; act quickly on loss of extension, infection or clot signs; return to sport usually takes 9 months or more.
summary.ur: Kabhi ghutne ke neeche takiya na rakhein; extension khone, infection ya clot ki alamaat par jaldi qadam uthayein; khel mein wapsi aam taur par 9 mahine ya zyada leti hai.

front.en: Four early goals after ACL reconstruction?
front.ur: ACL reconstruction ke baad chaar shuruati goals?

back.en: Full extension, quadriceps control, minimal swelling, normal walking.
back.ur: Poora extension, quadriceps control, kam se kam sujan, normal chalna.

front.en: Why no pillow under the knee?
front.ur: Ghutne ke neeche takiya kyun nahi?

back.en: It lets the knee stiffen bent and lose extension.
back.ur: Yeh ghutne ko mora hua akarne aur extension khone deta hai.

front.ur: Daurna aam taur par kab shuru hota hai?

back.en: Around 3 months, when criteria are met.
back.ur: Takreeban 3 mahine, jab criteria poore hon.

front.ur: Khel mein wapsi ka aam sab se jaldi waqt?

back.en: Usually 9 months or more, with criteria met.
back.ur: Aam taur par 9 mahine ya zyada, criteria poore hone par.
